profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at L3Harris Technologies
profile.summary:
With over five years at L3Harris Technologies, my role as Senior Software Engineer has centered on leading technical projects and serving as a Subject Matter Expert for an extensive portfolio of web and mobile applications. My proactive approach has been instrumental in enhancing operational continuity and user satisfaction by effectively addressing production issues.

Work Authorization: US Citizen. Security clearance: TS/SCI cleared.

If you would like to connect, I can be reached either through this profile or feel free to contact me directly at esther.hernandez15@gmail.com.

positions.title: Senior Specialist Software Engineer
positions.description:
• As a Technical Project Lead and Subject Matter Expert (SME) for 20+ web/mobile apps, I proactively and efficiently addressed production issues, minimizing downtime, and ensuring rapid issue resolution, thereby enhancing operational continuity and user satisfaction.
• Contributed as a core team member in designing, developing, and integrating features, conducting code reviews resulting in an 85% decrease in post-release bugs, and actively engaged in unit testing and DevOps practices, leading to a 20% increase in test coverage.
• Held a vital role in the successful adoption and implementation of Agile methodologies, leading to a 20% increase in project efficiency and fostering collaboration among team members, resulting in a reduction in project timelines.
• Implemented an efficient automation solution that reduced a developer's workload by streamlining a repetitive time-consuming process, resulting in a 98% reduction in time and resource expenditure.
• Successfully designed and implemented a CI/CD pipeline, automating code building, security scanning, and unit testing processes, resulting in enhanced development and code quality.
• Managed and executed quarterly software releases across multiple environments, consistently meeting or exceeding release deadlines with a 96% on-time delivery rate and reducing deployment errors by 98% through streamlined release processes.
• Implemented automation processes for quarterly installations, significantly reducing manual command execution, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring error-free deployments.
• Documented and maintained a comprehensive knowledge base, serving as a valuable resource for the team.
• Mentored and onboarded new hires, facilitating integration into the organization while providing technical knowledge and guidance.

positions.title: Information Systems Specialist - Consultant at Pfizer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented applications for DeltaV batch processes and regulatory compliance reporting, crucial for ensuring plant-wide adherence to industry regulations.
• Generated software technical documentation as per user specifications and GMP regulations, achieving a 95% compliance rate with regulatory standards and reducing documentation review time, thereby enhancing operational efficiency, and ensuring adherence to industry best practices.
• Conducted qualification procedures for computer systems, resulting in a 98% success rate in achieving compliance with industry standards, thereby enhancing operational reliability and ensuring optimal functionality in support of critical business operations.
• Reduced manufacturing downtime by implementing solutions which improved plant efficiency and sped up delivering products to Pfizerʼs clients.
• Contributed on DCS system PROVOX to DeltaV migration project with equipment module software logic and operator graphic displays.
• Developed applications which integrate with Data Historians including Aspen InfoPlus.21, OSIsoft and Automsoft.
• Administered Business Process Management (BPM) software, resulting in a 20% increase in workflow efficiency, thereby enhancing operational efficiency and contributing to overall cost savings.
• Conducted training sessions for end users and IT specialists, ensuring seamless adoption and proficiency within the organization.
• Led the migration and conversion of multiple legacy applications from VB6 to VB.NET, improving code quality and ensuring long-term maintainability.
